sources.title: The new 2022 BMW i4 eDrive40 and i4 M50 (BMW Group US newsroom)
sources.notes: Spec table: 81.1 kWh net usable, NMC-811 cells, 398.5 V, up to 200 kW DC, 11 kW single-phase AC, 10-80% 31 min; anticipatory thermal management pre-conditions the battery when navigation routes to a fast charger; My BMW app can schedule charging and pre-conditioning. Same figures for eDrive40 and M50.

sources.title: The new 2022 BMW i4 eDrive40 and i4 M50 (BMW Group Canada newsroom)
sources.notes: Canadian release: 83.9 kWh gross / 81.5 kWh net, 200 kW DC, 11 kW AC single-phase, 10-80% 31 min, 398.5 V, NMC-811, battery pre-conditioned automatically when navigation schedules a fast-charging stop.

sources.title: The 2023 BMW i4 eDrive35 (BMW Group US newsroom)
sources.notes: 67 kWh net usable, up to 180 kW DC, 10-80% in 32 min (early testing). Gross, chemistry, voltage, AC and preconditioning not stated on the page.

sources.title: BMW Group Canada announces the new 2023 BMW i4 eDrive35, orders now open
sources.notes: 66 kWh net, 70.2 kWh gross, 180 kW DC, 11 kW AC, 10-80% in as little as 32 min. Chemistry and preconditioning not mentioned.

sources.title: 2026 BMW i4 update measures (BMW Group US newsroom)
sources.notes: Lists SiC inverters, range gains and M50 renamed M60; says nothing about a pack, charger or charging-software change, which supports carrying the 2022 pack and preconditioning figures to 2025-2026.

sources.title: BMW i4 (G26) 70.2 kWh 286hp eDrive35 (auto-data.net)
sources.notes: Lists Li-NMC chemistry, 400 V, 70.2 kWh gross / 67 kWh usable. DC and AC fields are behind a login.

sources.title: BMW i4 eDrive35 (EV Database, 2025-2026 listing)
sources.notes: Lists 67.1 kWh usable / 70.3 nominal, 180 kW DC, 11 kW AC for the July 2025 on the eDrive35; says it succeeds the eDrive35 sold June 2024 to July 2025 (same acceleration, similar consumption; the page does not say the charging figures are unchanged).

sources.title: BMW EVs Can Now Charge At Tesla Superchargers (InsideEVs)
sources.notes: US access from the week of 2025-12-10 for i4, i5, i7, iX with an adapter (BMW EVs use CCS ports; Lectron adapter recommended); compatibility varies by model year, 2025 cars should work.

sources.title: Lectron Vortex Plus for BMW (vendor page)
sources.notes: Vendor page lists the BMW i4 for model years 2022-2026 as compatible with the CCS-to-NACS Vortex Plus adapter (confirms CCS port on 2022-2026 i4). Vendor marketing, not a BMW statement.

sources.title: BMW Canada further improves EV convenience in Canada with Shell Recharge integration and access to NACS-format Superchargers (2026-04-08)
sources.notes: Re-read 2026-11-19: all BEV models become Supercharger-compatible once software prerequisites are met (except original i3 and MINI Cooper SE F56); existing CCS-port cars must use the approved Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter. The i4 is not named in the text. All-new BMW models in Canada starting in 2026 (iX3, i3) get a built-in NACS port; only those.

sources.title: The all-new 2021 Volkswagen ID.4 electric SUV (Volkswagen of America launch release, reproduced on ConceptCarz)
sources.notes: Relays the VW US launch release: 82 kWh gross, 125 kW DC (5-80% in about 38 min), 11 kW onboard charger, CCS socket, 12 modules of 288 pouch cells. Net capacity and voltage not stated.

sources.title: 2022 Volkswagen ID.4 range boosted, now up to 280 miles (Green Car Reports)
sources.notes: 2022 ID.4 still uses an 82 kWh pack; DC peak 135 kW versus the previous 125 kW (over-the-air update still to come at time of writing).

sources.title: 2023 Volkswagen ID.4 First Drive (SlashGear)
sources.notes: 62 kWh pack has 58 kWh usable and peaks at 140 kW; 82 kWh pack has 77 kWh usable and up to 170 kW (up from 135); onboard 11 kW charger.

sources.title: US-made 2023 Volkswagen ID.4 is better equipped, cheaper at $37,495 (InsideEVs)
sources.notes: 2023 Pro and AWD Pro get DC fast charging up to 170 kW; Standard has the 62 kWh pack. No gross/usable, AC or Standard peak on the page.

sources.title: 2024 Volkswagen ID.4: More Power, $41,160 Base Price (Cars.com)
sources.notes: 2024 US: 62 kWh pack on Standard and S (140 kW, 10-80% about 30 min); 82 kWh pack on Pro/Pro S/Pro S Plus RWD or AWD (175 kW, about 30 min).

sources.title: Volkswagen ID.4 (Wikipedia)
sources.notes: Battery table for North America: 2021-22 82 kWh 125 kW raised to 135 kW by OTA (LG cells); 2023 62 kWh 140 kW (SK On); 2023 82 kWh RWD 170 kW (SK On) or 135 kW (LG), all AWD SK On; 2024 on 82 kWh 175 kW; 62 kWh gross/58 usable, 82/77 usable; onboard AC 11 kW for 62 and 82 kWh packs; 24-cell modules (9 modules on the 62 pack, 12 on the 82), same cell family. Secondary source; table alignment uncertain.

sources.title: Volkswagen ID.4 Standard 2024 specs (ArenaEV)
sources.notes: 62 kWh total / 58 kWh usable, CCS 140 kW DC, 11 kW AC, 10-80% 29 min, "400V type" liquid-cooled Li-ion. Chemistry not stated; mixes US and EU data.

sources.title: Volkswagen ID.4 2025 Base specifications (Guide Auto, Canada)
sources.notes: Canadian 2025 ID.4 Base: 62.0 kWh lithium-ion, 400 V, RWD, 201 hp, 332 km. No charging kW on the page.

sources.title: Volkswagen ID.4 2025 Pro AWD specifications (Guide Auto, Canada)
sources.notes: Canadian 2025 ID.4 Pro AWD: 82.0 kWh lithium-ion, 400 V, AWD.

sources.title: thinkEV Canada - 2026 Volkswagen ID.4
sources.notes: Lists CCS1, 135 kW DC, NMC 82 kWh; names only a Base version and unnamed longer-range versions.

sources.title: 2026 ID.4 (vw.com)
sources.notes: Quick charging about 28 min in optimal conditions, up to 11 kW home charging, Supercharger use needs the Volkswagen-approved NACS DC adapter sold separately. Lists Pro, Pro S, AWD Pro, AWD Pro S, AWD Pro S Plus (no 62 kWh trim).

sources.title: Cold weather care for your EV (vw.com newsroom)
sources.notes: Battery Optimization for most 2024 and newer VW EV models (screens labelled 2024 ID.4 Pro S): Charging Settings toggle, and the car starts preheating the battery automatically when an active route to a DC fast charger is set.

sources.title: EV energy management (vw.ca)
sources.notes: Same Battery Optimization text for most 2024 and newer VW EVs: manual (infotainment) and automatic (route to a DC fast charger).

sources.title: VW and Skoda EV owners have waited years for battery preconditioning (InsideEVs)
sources.notes: ID.4/ID.5 built 2020-2024 lacked battery preconditioning; from 2024 all came with automatic battery preconditioning; software 3.9.1 adds a manual button only (below 20 C). Market not stated (European-sourced).

sources.title: Volkswagen introduces battery preconditioning for older ID. models (electrive)
sources.notes: Software 3.9.1 for ID.4/ID.5 built before October 2023 (needs 3.7+), manual activation via a new infotainment screen; automatic navigation activation belongs to 4.x/5.x software. Markets not stated (German sources).

sources.title: Volkswagen EVs finally get access to Tesla Superchargers for real this time (Electrek)
sources.notes: ID.4 and ID. Buzz owners in North America get Supercharger access from 2025-11-18 with a $200 (CAD 304) NACS adapter; MY2026+ VW EVs come with the adapter included; no port hardware change described.

sources.title: NACS DC adapter (vw.ca)
sources.notes: The NACS DC adapter is officially available for the ID.4 and ID. Buzz, unlocking Tesla NACS partner Superchargers across Canada and the US; no model years named; no native NACS port mentioned.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Cars.com 2024 US: 82 kWh versions 175 kW (up from 170), 10-80% about 30 min; Wikipedia 175 kW from 2024; vw.com 2026 page claims about 28 min.
